description: Fast search slicer for Power BI: a type-ahead search box with autocomplete suggestions, fuzzy matching, contains or exact search, multi-select, and paste-a-list bulk filtering. What built-in slicer search can't do. A built-in slicer searches one field, exactly as typed. Autocomplete Filter indexes values in the browser as they load, so suggestions come back on every keystroke with no round-trip to the data model, on high-cardinality fields like customer names, SKUs, order IDs, part numbers, addresses and emails, tested with millions of rows. It forgives typos, searches several columns at once, takes a pasted list of hundreds of IDs, and shows what you'll filter to before you commit, with a count or related value beside each match. Get the matched values back out. No slicer does this: expand a partial or misspelled term into the exact values it matched, map a pasted list term by term, and copy the results to Excel as comma- or line-delimited text. New in 6.0 Also Search — one box searches up to four more columns, even from related tables; suggestions are grouped by column, and each pick filters the column it came from Saved sets — build a filter list once and save it by name; its chip restores that exact list for every viewer, next to your quick picks and each viewer's recent searches Paste report — paste hundreds of IDs from Excel and see how many matched exactly, inexactly or…
